Q: How to calculate the percentages of a SQL column's value distribution A:

I simply use this when ever I need to work out a percentage..

ROUND(CAST((Numerator * 100.0 / Denominator) AS FLOAT), 2) AS Percentage

Note that 100.0 returns 1 decimal, whereas 100 on it's own will round up the result to the nearest whole number, even with the ROUND(...,2) function!

Q: What is the grammar of GADTs and ADTs in GHC2024? A:

As far as I can tell there is no difference between these three variants.

There is a grammar for GADT syntax in the GHC User Manual: https://downloads.haskell.org/ghc/latest/docs/users_guide/exts/gadt_syntax.html#formal-syntax-for-gadts

Q: After fork(), parent process terminates when child calls exec() A:

This appears to be the result of the parent process using SDL. I created an isolated test taking SDL out of the equation, and while I am still having problems with it, the parent process does not terminate.

In short: If you have called SDL_Init, do not expect that you will be able to successfully fork().

Q: Error 0x80092006 when signing .mst file in InstallShield A:

There was a similar issue with InstallShield 2011 that raised this error number. Something to do with the way the Certificate Password was stored. Might be worth creating a new certificate and sign it again on Windows 11
